plugins.name: obsidian-router
plugins.description: Slash commands, skills, sub-agents, and hooks for the obsidian-mcp-router multi-vault MCP server. Provides /obsidian-router:* commands for: (1) the 14 router primitives (vault discovery, reads, writes, frontmatter, file management, Templater); (2) a Karpathy-style LLM-wiki workflow stack (wiki / wiki-ingest / wiki-query / wiki-lint / wiki-fold); (3) high-level utilities (save, autoresearch, canvas, defuddle, obsidian-bases, obsidian-markdown).
